Burden per respondent path

Source: R/path_burden.R
path_burden.Rd

Joins resolve_paths() to score_burden() and reports, for every flow path, a burden band: the floor (only always-shown questions, loop blocks run once) and the ceiling (every reachable question, loop blocks run to their maximum). The true burden of any actual respondent on that path lies between.

Usage

path_burden(
  qsf,
  weights = gfs_weights(),
  max_paths = 10000L,
  paths = NULL,
  scored = NULL
)

Arguments

qsf

A qsf_raw object from read_qsf().

weights

A gfs_weights() list.

max_paths

Passed to resolve_paths().

paths, scored

Optional precomputed resolve_paths() and score_burden() results for this qsf (internal reuse; NULL computes them here, leaving the public behaviour unchanged).

Value

A tibble, one row per flow path: path_id, terminates_early, n_blocks, n_q_floor, n_q_ceiling, gfs_floor, gfs_ceiling, min_minutes, max_minutes, n_gates.
